purpose: Three additional main-character design candidates, same approved pixel-art language
status: New concept candidates, user review pending; previously accepted starting appearance retained

variants.name: 작업모 정비사
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / character design variation.
Create ONE alternative full-body protagonist concept by editing the supplied approved character reference. Same game, same world: an adult ammunition technician exploring a dangerous, partly inhabited, dystopian weather-control tower. This is an alternative candidate for the main character, not a class lineup or an NPC sheet.
STYLE LOCK: Match the supplied image's deliberately COARSE low-resolution pixel art. Large obvious square pixel blocks and clean staircase outlines, connected flat clusters, a tiny simplified face and only 2-3 color steps per material. About 65-80 logical pixels of character height, displayed cleanly enlarged. Consistent grid and pixel size everywhere. Long adult legs, roughly six-head adult proportions. Keep the original view, full-body framing, scale and grounded stance so the designs can be compared directly. Restrained desaturated industrial colors with one clear warm accent. Do NOT add micro-texture, polished metallic reflections, rendered muscles, detailed realistic face, soft shading, gradients, antialiasing or realistic concept painting.
POSE AND FUNCTION: facing right in three-quarter side view, ONE hand on the chest/backpack strap and the OTHER hand holding a simple industrial long gun by its grip at the hip with the barrel angled down-right. Exactly two arms, two hands, two legs. No additional hand or skin-colored fragment anywhere on the stock or barrel. Preserve the occupation through a few large cartridge silhouettes and a recognizable simple tool. Practical worn clothing with personality rather than armor clutter.
OUTPUT: one centered full-body character with entire head, boots and gun inside the square canvas, generous modest margins, transparent background and a small hard-edged pixel contact shadow immediately below the boots. No text, labels, UI, typography, panels, alternate views, companion characters, logos or watermark.

DESIGN A — COMPACT WORKSHOP TECHNICIAN. Clearly redesign the clothes/head and silhouette, not merely recolor the input.
Replace the helmet with a low-profile charcoal railway-mechanic work cap with a short straight brim and one small copper badge block on the side; no lamp. A few dark hair pixels at the nape and a plain exposed adult face. Short ochre-copper work jacket ending at the hips, open over a deep navy work shirt. Forearms in rolled cream cuffs. Slim charcoal trousers and sturdy low boots leave the leg silhouette long and clear. One broad diagonal canvas strap, small rectangular grey-green tool satchel at the rear hip instead of a tall backpack. Three large brass cartridges and a single blocky spanner at waist. Jacket is one broad readable warm ochre shape with dark elbows; minimize seams. This silhouette should feel nimble, practical and approachable, a resourceful resident mechanic. Keep the existing simple gun as a subordinate dark shape. Match the approved reference's coarse pixel scale exactly.

DESIGN C — LONG-COAT TOWER SALVAGER. Clearly redesign clothes/head and silhouette, not merely recolor the input.
Replace the rounded helmet with a small angular slate-grey industrial rescue helmet: one asymmetrical raised crown ridge, a short wedge-shaped forward brim, and one broad faded cream marking. No glowing visor, no face mask, no horns or wide-brim hat. Adult exposed profile beneath the brim. A long dark desaturated blue-grey work coat reaching just below the knees, two strongly separated split tails, a muted brick-red folded shoulder cape/yoke over ONE shoulder, simple black work gloves and substantial brown boots. The upper coat is narrow and controlled rather than massive armor. A small flat rear tool pack and three large brass cartridges on an asymmetrical hip belt. The red shoulder is a single bold shape, not a flowing scarf. Only a few large flat coat shadows; preserve negative space between the legs and gun. Looks quietly determined and experienced, not sinister or supernatural. Give the small head, long coat and asymmetrical red shoulder a strong readable silhouette. Keep the simple industrial gun and the exact approved coarse pixel-art language.

verification: All three displayed outputs visually inspected. Full figures, distinct headwear and coat silhouettes, consistent coarse pixel treatment. Copy SHA256 verified. No post-processing or runtime integration. Strict native pixel grid, weapon/hand cleanup and animation consistency require production work.
